title: Riot X Nic Salts Pink Lemonade & Lime 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pink Lemon and Lime by Riot X offers a citrus twist on the classic pink lemonade vape. Red berries bring a touch of sweetness, followed by bright Lemonade and a sharp kick of Lime that cuts through with clarity. The result is a refreshing fruit blend with plenty of zing and a clean finish. Blended with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine — a clever fusion of nicotine salts and freebase nicotine — this e-liquid delivers quick absorption with a smooth but noticeable throat hit. Its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent performance in MTL pod kits , vape pens and vape starter kits . Riot X Nic Salts are made in the UK and crafted for vapers who want bold, double-concentrated flavour in a practical 10ml format. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
